title: everyday parts, a seventh round: an enclosure, a pipe elbow, a flanged pipe, a split lid, a drafted box, a mirrored pocket, a gear-like disc, a keyed shaft

cases.name: c001
cases.description: an enclosure: a 60 × 40 × 30 box, its upright edges filleted 5, shelled 2 open at its top, bosses (radius 3) from its floor to z = 25 near each corner with holes (radius 1.2) 15 deep

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a pipe elbow: a circle (radius 5) swept up 20, round a quarter circle (radius 20) and on 20, shelled 1 open at both ends

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a flanged pipe: a tube (radii 5 and 7, 30 tall) on a flange (radius 15, 3 thick) revolved, a bolt hole (radius 1.5) at 11 patterned six times round it, the tube's joint with the flange filleted 1

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a 50 × 40 × 20 box with its top edges filleted 3, split into a lid by a plane at z = 15

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a 40 × 30 × 20 box with its four sides drafted 5° from its bottom

cases.name: c006
cases.description: a 60 × 30 × 10 block with a 15 × 20 pocket 4 deep at one end, mirrored as a feature across x = 30

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a gear-like disc: a disc (radius 20, 5 thick), a trapezoidal tooth out to 24 made as a part and patterned sixteen times, all united, a hole (radius 4) with a keyway to 5.5 through its middle

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a stepped shaft (radius 10 for 20, then radius 7 to 45) revolved, a keyway (3 wide, 1.5 deep, z = 25 to 40) cut in its narrow end, its end and step edges chamfered 0.8 and 1
